claim: The 2024 Mihindu Seya commemorative stele records the restoration as a contemporary religious-heritage project under Archaeology Department supervision and names Sri Lanka Navy and other armed-forces labour among contributors.
bounded_by: Primary evidence for the 2024 commemorative act only; it does not validate the ancient narrative written on the stone.
notes: Field T0. This claim is the Sinhala-heartland comparator for post-war military civilian engagement.
